notes.title: Maltiplay mode release!!
notes.content:
2018/07/17 and Vecpoly Game mounted a multi-play mode on "Beginner'sGame".
It's connected at the same time now, several, even 20 people, and, it's being done, but a player will go to increase as well as increase the number of simultaneous connections from now on.
A war of 1on1 is developed by a multi-play mode.
There is also a possibility that a mode will be increased from now on, so please enjoy yourself!

notes.title: Update is coming!
notes.content:
The Beginner'sgame update was released on June 23, 2018 at Japan time.
We have implemented high score mode as a major change.
This feature is not a full-fledged implementation because of the preview function, but by implementing a function that can be called the origin of this game, it was a game that can be fun and play long time.
This is the main change.
Thank you in the future.

notes.title: dev blog (5/11)
notes.content:
Hello, this is くそげーみゅーじあむ.
I would like to tell the production situation of the game one day at a time from this time.
Today (5/11) I made a prop of the stage 2 cut scene and made the remaining one object, I could finish the place where I can specify the animation.
For the game, we made the story of Japanese halfway, added enemy animation, and attack characteristics.
On today(5/12), it will be completed up to the place where you can play only with the stage 2 excluding the cut scene.
By the way, if it is said that the rendering of the cut scene will take, it will not end unless you leave your computer on for a full three-day long, long, half a day. If you crash on the way (things that forcibly terminate the software in the middle), it will be like a feeling that you have ended my life.
There are such things and we are setting the price.
Since developers are Japanese, we accept Japanese questions as well.
I hope you will continue to look at this blog (Production Status Report).
